name: TaxIntuitive
subtitle: Canadian money skills
description:
Build confidence with Canadian taxes and everyday money decisions. TaxIntuitive offers short lessons, practice quizzes, a money simulator, and Quiz Duo challenges with friends. Learn as a guest, or create an account to sync progress and play Quiz Duo.

TaxIntuitive provides general educational information, not tax, legal, or financial advice. Confirm current rules with the Canada Revenue Agency.
releaseNotes: First iOS release with Canadian financial education lessons, practice quizzes, a simulator and Quiz Duo.
reviewNotes: Lessons and practice are available without signing in. Quiz Duo requires an account. Reviewer credentials and a second-player test procedure must be supplied before review.
